thread:
laura_platt: Quick sync — onboarding OroModel (open checkpoint) into marketplace. Need licensing + distribution approach before we publish. Ping @anne_legal and @samir_k. Proposed timeline: legal vet + addendum by Mon, packaging + HW tests Tue, marketplace listing Wed. Any immediate blockers?

samir_k: Sounds OK. Anne — any red flags? License looks MIT-ish but has an ambiguous clause about commercial redistribution. We need clarity about redistributing quantized binaries in HW bundles. :thinking:

anne_legal: Looking now. Short answer: the upstream grant allows redistribution but forbids sublicensing. That affects SI/hardware bundles where partner wants to bundle the model as part of their appliance. I'll draft a lightweight distribution addendum to cover prequantized artifacts and channel partners.

laura_platt: If addendum is required, can we default to two paths: (1) Hosted/API-only (no artifact redistribution), (2) Artifact distribution via addendum for SI/hw partners. Nimbus (HW partner) prefers prebuilt container images for their devices.

mike_sanders: Confirmed — Nimbus asked for the ability to ship quantized *.pt and a signed container. They also asked about attribution text and whether we must display the upstream copyright in UI.

anne_legal: Draft clause proposal (summary): "Provider grants Redwood a non-exclusive right to redistribute compiled and quantized model artifacts to end customers via Redwood and Redwood channel partners. Provider retains copyright and may require attribution. Redistribution excludes sublicensing unless separately agreed." I'll post full text to the partner folder and tag @mike_sanders.

jess_tang: From product/marketplace side — we need standardized SKU metadata so ops + partners can integrate. Proposed fields: model_version, quantization_profile, supported_hardware, license_type, redistrib_allowed(true|false), attribution_text. Example manifest snippet we can embed in UI: 

```
{
  "model_id": "oro-v2",
  "quant_profile": "int8",
  "redistrib_allowed": true,
  "regions": ["us-west1","eu-central1"]
}
```

laura_platt: Good. Also we should create a "runtime-only" SKU that points to the hosted model id (no artifact). Legal addendum only applies to artifact SKUs.

anne_legal: Two confirmation questions before I finalize the addendum: (1) Do we require provider indemnity related to export controls and (2) Are weights dual-licensed (research vs commercial)? If they are dual-licensed we need explicit mapping in the addendum.

samir_k: For export controls — recommend we include a per-region distribution flag in the marketplace manifest and prevent artifact downloads if region is restricted. We already have region-level deployment flags in the infra.

mike_sanders: Alternative for restricted regions: ship a signed runtime image that performs a runtime handshake instead of handing over raw weights. That satisfies some partners who can't export weights but can run signed containers locally.

jess_tang: Marketing note: coordinate announcement with partner PR. Suggest embargo until addendum is signed. Timeline: legal sign-off Tue, partner OK Wed, announcement Fri. I'll draft the joint blog + marketplace banner once we have final wording.

laura_platt: Action items: (1) @anne_legal draft addendum (EOD), (2) @samir_k add redistrib flags to marketplace manifest schema (tomorrow), (3) @mike_sanders confirm Nimbus packaging constraints and signed image flow, (4) @jess_tang draft announcement + embargo plan. I'll track in GH issue #3445. :eyes:

laura_platt: One more Q: any objections to showing two distribution modes on the listing: "Hosted API (no artifacts)" and "Partner Appliance (artifact license required)"? Safer than a single checkbox.

anne_legal: No objections. Addendum will include attribution, export-control compliance obligations, and a clear no-sublicense default. If partner needs broader redistribution or sublicensing rights they must sign a commercial license amendment.

samir_k: I'll drop a migration note for any existing internal deployments using raw weights to move to signed images or hosted APIs; will post in #eng-runtime.

laura_platt: Great — thanks all. Will reconvene after draft addendum is up. :thumbsup:
